'''Zsinj's Empire''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that ruled a vast region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] led by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. It was established in the [[Quelii Oversector]], where Zsinj was [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]], before expanding outward from there.

==History==
{{Main|Zsinj}}
Zsinj's Empire was created following [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death, after Zsinj ''de facto'' refused to recognize the authority of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and became an independent warlord. In the immediate upheaval following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Zsinj never denied his loyalty to the Empire Proper—a lesson seemingly learned from the bombastic denunciation [[Maarisa Zsinj|his proud mother]], an Imperial fleet commander, had issued before she went rogue and was thereafter hunted down by her own son.<ref name="TIW:DoaE">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-1|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

After setting up his capital on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], Zsinj began referring to himself first and foremost by his title of Warlord of the Empire and symbolically renamed his Super Star Destroyer [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] after his old ship, locking down Quelii Oversector with staggering viciousness and success.<ref name="TIW:DoaE" /> However, the Ruling Council's advisers supported his tactics at first, so his break with central authority was not entirely evident.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

While Zsinj dealt with threats from local rebels ruthlessly, he also sent emissaries to the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. Soon to declare itself the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the diplomatic contacts the warlord established enabled the self-proclaimed heir of the Old Republic to concentrate on defeating the Imperial government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>

Zsinj's diplomatic relations with other factions of the [[Imperial Civil War]] varied. There were conflicts with [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]] and [[Ardus Kaine]]'s [[Pentastar Alignment]], while the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] and loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] (where the warlord still had allies like [[Admiral]] [[Llon Banjeer]]) coexisted peacefully alongside Zsinj's Empire.<ref name="TEA" />

Zsinj recruited some [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] into his forces, focusing especially on those with an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] background. He also created a vast support network independent from his military force.<ref name="XWWS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> Having consolidated his forces, the warlord took over the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], extended his protection to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and annexed some territory along the Hydian Way abandoned by Ardus Kaine, extending his empire as far as [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

During this time, [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] became one of the most important worlds of Zsinj's Empire: the warlord built the orbital complex [[Rancor Base]], started [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on Dathomir's [[Koratas|fourth moon]], and initiated some of his many special projects.<ref name="CTD" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5]]&ndash;[[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Zsinj's Empire's relations with the New Republic became heated. [[Mon Calamari]] fleet admirals [[Kalback]] and [[Ragab]] attempted to gain a foothold on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], both [[Battle of Corsin (5 ABY)|were repelled]] by Zsinj's forces.<ref name="TEA" /> New Republic plans to attack Zsinj had existed since [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], but were sidetracked first by the [[Battle of the Hast Shipyards]] with the loyalist Empire, then with the emergence of [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]]. Viewing both his Imperial and New Republic opponents as inferior, Zsinj eventually felt secure enough in his power to challenge the New Republic directly. Controlling his forces from Rancor Base, Zsinj became increasingly ambitious,<ref name="CTD" /> going as far as to [[Battle of New Alderaan (Hunt for Zsinj)|attack]] New Republic colonies at [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] and [[Selcaron]].<ref name="TIW:DoaE" />

After the fall of Coruscant, forces previously loyal to the Coruscant Imperial government joined Zsinj's Empire, including members of [[Ysanne Isard]]'s Imperial Intelligence. At the height of his power, Zsinj had gained control over a mammoth area of the known galaxy, absorbing the holdings of rivals Grand Moff [[Nigel Nivers]] and Admiral [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] (whom he executed), and challenging the authority of the New Republic and Empire alike.<ref name="TIW:DoaE" /><ref name="FH1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

Ultimately, war with the New Republic proved disastrous for Zsinj's Empire. Zsinj himself was [[Hunt for Zsinj|"hunted"]] by the [[Solo Fleet]], which forced him to retreat after forming a temporary alliance with the forces of the Galactic Empire under Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]], crippling his illicit financial network and defeating his forces in a string of engagements.

The warlord was later killed at Rancor Base on Dathomir by Han Solo in the midst of a pitched battle with the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] and the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Singing Mountain Clan]].

Zsinj's death left the Galactic Empire free to return their focus to the New Republic. The warlord's holdings were contested by Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of the New Republic, Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] of the loyalist Empire, and Teradoc of the Greater Maldrood, with Ackbar as the clear winner. While Zsinj's forces remained active, they lacked direction. Much of his fleet was claimed by a number of independent warlords, most notably Teradoc.

==Military==
Zsinj's Empire continued to use old Imperial vehicles as the bulk of its fleet. Zsinj called upon multiple [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in battle.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Talasea]] Zsinj's forces used a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] and a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="XWWS" /> Other ships included [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]], [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]], [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]] and [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]].<ref name="SoloCommand">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> Zsinj's Empire was also in possession of more exotic tools of war such as the [[orbital nightcloak]]s and Zsinj's flagship, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''Iron Fist''.

Zsinj's forces primarily used standard Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. However, the [[Rancor Base]] also designed an unofficial Zsinj-exclusive TIE variant named [[TIE/rpt starfighter|TIE Raptor]]. Although not as fast as a TIE Interceptor, this fighter was as maneuverable as an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]], and heavily armed, with four laser cannons and two concussion missile tubes. A few prototypes were also equipped with shields. In addition, several Victory Star Destroyers at Dathomir were also equipped with Z-95 Headhunter fighters, deploying them in the battle against Isolder's Battle Dragon.

While part of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] was under Zsinj's command,<ref name="IronFist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> the lack of [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]] or [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities meant that the numbers of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] began to dwindle. Unlike other [[Warlord/Legends#After Endor|warlords]] who chose to equip regular [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army Troopers]] with stormtrooper armor, Zsinj took a different path. He created the [[Raptors]], a special-forces unit charged with enforcing Zsinj's will throughout his growing territory. Arguably more loyal to Zsinj than the stormtroopers had been to Emperor Palpatine and his legal successors, they were commonly considered the most recognizable symbol of the warlord's power.
